name: zgeometry_model_build_polygon_uv_list
description: zGeometry_Model::BuildPolygonUvList derives U/V axis coefficients from a polygon UV basis and produces UV pairs for an arbitrary point list.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46a7f0 validates vertex-index lookup, two SolveUvAxisCoefficientsXZ calls for U and V, pointCount-sized UV allocation, per-point delta from basis vertex 1, coefficient application, and result return.
The native model UV/DI smoke verifies generated UV pairs for a three-point list against known affine U/V coefficients.
